policy.midpoint_stop: At 720 stop if hop 1 or 2 drops by at least 6 correct of 96 against the same R480 condition under canonical or random0.

calibration.select: First protocol with >=6/8 valid and 1..7 correct; reject after two failures.

deployment.floor: After first six pairs stop if either arm has fewer than two valid answers.
deployment.candidate: Qualified child or R480 if installation fails.

transfer.requires: all exposure and cross-order mechanism gates; independent of chat calibration
transfer.orders: epoch 0 map schedule; deterministic new display; cycle 1-3 by update
transfer.promotion: Gain >=3pp in unrestricted third-hop state-machine digits against installed checkpoint, both retention safeguards; diagnose bypass on a meaningful digit gain.

registration.dense_advantage: positive mean random-order terminal accuracy at hop 3 over best dense arm
